spec.description:
This dashboard provides a resource usage overview of the ArgoCD components.

It includes CPU and Memory requests, limits and usage. In addition, the last termination reason is plotted and the cache hit ratio is available.

targets.expr: max(argocd_info{cluster="$cluster"}) by (version)

max by (pod) (
  irate(container_cpu_usage_seconds_total{cluster="$cluster", container="application-controller"}[$__interval]))
sum(max_over_time(container_memory_working_set_bytes{cluster="$cluster",container="application-controller"}[$__interval])) by (pod)

max by (pod) (
  irate(container_cpu_usage_seconds_total{cluster="$cluster", container="applicationset-controller"}[$__interval]))
sum(max_over_time(container_memory_working_set_bytes{cluster="$cluster", container=~"applicationset-controller.*"}[$__interval])) by (pod)

max by (pod) (
  irate(container_cpu_usage_seconds_total{cluster="$cluster", container="dex-server"}[$__interval]))
sum(container_memory_working_set_bytes{cluster="$cluster", container=~"dex-server"}) by (pod)
kube_pod_container_status_last_terminated_reason{cluster="$cluster", pod=~"argocd-dex-server.*"} != 0

max by (pod) (
  irate(container_cpu_usage_seconds_total{cluster="$cluster", container="notifications-controller"}[$__interval]))
sum(container_memory_working_set_bytes{cluster="$cluster", container=~"notifications-controller"}) by (pod)
kube_pod_container_status_last_terminated_reason{cluster="$cluster", pod=~"argocd-notifications-controller.*"} != 0

max by (pod) (
  irate(container_cpu_usage_seconds_total{cluster="$cluster", container="haproxy"}[$__interval]))
sum(max_over_time(container_memory_working_set_bytes{cluster="$cluster",container="haproxy"}[$__interval])) by (pod)
kube_pod_container_status_last_terminated_reason{cluster="$cluster", pod=~"argocd-redis-ha-haproxy.*"} != 0
sum(max_over_time(container_memory_working_set_bytes{cluster="$cluster", container=~"redis|sentinel|split-brain-fix"}[$__interval])) by (pod)
kube_pod_container_status_last_terminated_reason{cluster="$cluster", pod=~"argocd-redis-ha-server.*"} != 0

max by (pod) (
  irate(container_cpu_usage_seconds_total{cluster="$cluster", container="repo-server"}[$__interval]))
sum(max_over_time(container_memory_working_set_bytes{cluster="$cluster",container="repo-server"}[$__interval])) by (pod)
kube_pod_container_status_last_terminated_reason{cluster="$cluster", pod=~"repo-server.*"} != 0

max by (pod) (
  irate(container_cpu_usage_seconds_total{cluster="$cluster", container="server"}[$__interval]))
sum(max_over_time(container_memory_working_set_bytes{cluster="$cluster",container="server"}[$__interval])) by (pod)
kube_pod_container_status_last_terminated_reason{cluster="$cluster", pod=~"server.*"} != 0
